**Gateway 503 incident — on-call handoff**

**Root cause:** deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14, "connection-per-request for pool isolation"). It applied config generation 119 at 02:13:41Z, flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true` and raising the upstream timeout from 2000ms to 2500ms. Connections started being held per-request instead of shared, so the fixed pool of 20 filled up and stopped freeing.

**Impact window:** first slow-acquire warning at 02:14:14Z, first 503 at 02:14:18Z, every one tagged `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`. Still ongoing at the end of the log (03:59:27Z) — the waiting queue climbed from 13 to 74 over that time and never recovered on its own.

**Scope:** gateway only. `logs/worker.log` shows no 503s or pool errors in this window, just one unrelated known-issue warning (`OPS-2210`, slow unindexed query).

**Action:** roll back `dep-4471`.
